omissions.description: POST /todos does not validate that the title field is non-empty and return 400 with a message indicating 'The Title field is required' when title is empty or missing
omissions.reasoning: The specification states: 'Call POST /todos with an empty or missing title field. Verify that the response status code is 400 Bad Request and the response body contains a validation error indicating The Title field is required.' The code defines title as a plain str in TodoCreate with no minimum-length constraint, so an empty string ('') would be accepted without error.

omissions.description: PUT /todos/{id} does not validate that the id in the request body matches the id in the URL path and return 400 Bad Request when they differ
omissions.reasoning: The specification states: 'Call PUT /todos/X with a request body where id=Y (different from X). Verify the response status is 400 Bad Request.' The code's update_todo handler never checks whether todo_in.id matches the path parameter id, so mismatched IDs are silently ignored.
